Virat_Kohli.bio: Virat Kohli is one of India's most successful international batters. He is known for his consistency, fitness, aggressive batting and leadership.
Virat_Kohli.career_history: Kohli represented India at Under-19 level before making his international debut. He became a key player across all three formats and served as captain of the Indian men's team.
major_achievements: ICC Cricket World Cup winner
ICC Champions Trophy winner
Former captain of the Indian cricket team
One of India's leading international run scorers
